title: GoWhere
line: A web app to discover and book attractions in Singapore.
problem: GoWhere was developed to help users discover and book tourist attractions across Singapore. It aims to improve the travel experience with one user-friendly platform for exploring destinations and managing bookings.
did: As a Full-stack Software Developer, I was responsible for implementing key user and admin features. This included authentication such as login, registration and password recovery, user profile management and a rewards system. On the admin side, I built dashboards and tools for managing users and rewards.
outcome: A fully working booking platform, deployed on Microsoft Azure.
